title: Pro Shop Store Credit: one account per member
content:
## Basis
Pro Shop Store Credit permits a member to hold at most 1 store-credit account that is not closed, at any given time. A new store-credit account may not be opened for a member while that member already has an existing store-credit account sitting in any lifecycle status other than closed.

## Restated
| Existing account status | New account permitted |
|---|---|
| No existing account, or the member's only prior account is closed | Yes |
| Applied | No |
| Active | No |
| Suspended | No |

## Points of judgement
Only the closed status frees a member to open a new store-credit account; every other status — applied, active or suspended — blocks a second account from being opened for the same member. A member who wants a new account while an existing one sits in applied, active or suspended status must first bring that existing account to closed before a new one may be opened.
